reasons: Each row's visible time reads like "Nov 15, 2026, 2:16 AM" with no time zone. The zone appears only in a hidden copy-button label, so the visible time is bare. Status badges use words outside the five allowed (Dispatched, Bounced, Deferred, Suppressed, Rejected) in place of Sent, Failed, Delayed and Not sent. The screen is titled "Deliveries" instead of Activity, which breaks the product's word rules.
